messages.text:
Rita! We booked last Tuesday. Lisbon, 18 to 23 September, Puffin Vale Air. We land at 19:40 on the Thursday if nothing goes wrong. Niamh's never been and I've only ever seen the airport.

Are you around that week? No pressure to entertain us, but dinner at least.

And where should we stay? Somewhere we can walk home from at midnight without a taxi.

L

Hi Luis,

What lovely news. Yes, I'm here all of September. I have one deadline on the 30th and nothing else.

For staying, look at Blue Swallow Guesthouse in Bairro Alto. Six rooms, run by Joana, who is a friend of my cousin. Ask for the Blue Room: it's at the top and has the little balcony. The house is above the tile shop with the yellow door, so you will find it even at midnight.

And I want to take you both across the river one day. My aunt has a house in Cacilhas and she keeps asking when she can feed my London friends. A Sunday is best for her. Tremoco will come too, he is excellent on ferries.

Love, Rita

Sorry for the slow reply, flu has flattened me since Monday and I'm typing this under a blanket with Biscuit on my feet.

Sunday with your aunt: yes please, a hundred times. Tell her Niamh's vegetarian but I'll eat whatever she puts down.

Will email Joana once I can look at a screen for more than ten minutes.

L

Hi Luis,

Poor you. Drink something hot and stay away from screens completely.

My aunt is very pleased. Vegetarian is no problem, she will make the bean stew she cooks for Lent, which from her is a big compliment. I'll find out which ferry and tell you closer to the time, they change the timetable in September.

Love, Rita

Dear Mr. Luis,

Thank you again for staying with us in the Blue Room. I hope the journey home was easier than the journey here. When your flight was delayed on the 18th I was a little worried, but 23:10 is not the latest arrival we have had this year, so please don't think about it again. Duarte, who helps me in the mornings, says Niamh was the first guest this summer to finish the whole plate of queijadas.

I attach your invoice for the five nights: €575 with breakfast, showing the deposit of €172.50 you paid in August and the balance of €402.50 you paid at check-out. I also attach a photo Duarte took of you both on the balcony on the last morning, in case you would like to keep it.

I have one small favour to ask. We are a small house and most of our guests find us through reviews. If you have a few minutes, a short review on Nightjar Stays, or wherever you prefer, would help us very much. Two lines is enough.

Please give my regards to Rita. Her aunt telephoned me on Monday to say you had eaten everything, which from her is the highest praise.

Best regards, Joana

Joana Ferreira
Blue Swallow Guesthouse | Bairro Alto, Lisbon

messages.text:
Lu,

Mum just called me in a STATE. She went to the printer in Chapalita to look at the paper and the man told her the invitations are already PAID FOR. In full. By you. Please tell me that's a mistake, because Marc and I agreed we are paying for every single thing to do with this wedding, and you are already doing the design for free, which is MORE than enough.

Also she says he said 120 invitations and I'm sure we said 150. So now I don't know if he's confused or Mum's confused or I'm confused.

Can you please:
1. Tell me exactly what you paid and when, so Marc can put it in the spreadsheet and pay you back.
2. Check the number with the printer. It's 150. ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY.
3. Tell me where the final PDF is, the one with the gold, because Mum wants to show Aunt Lourdes and I can't find it.

I love the invitations. I just don't love you secretly paying for things.

Love, Dani

Dani, nobody's secretly paying for anything. The printer wanted it all upfront to hold the press for this week, and you were in back-to-back meetings, so I paid by card from here on Saturday: 8,640 pesos, which was about CA$640 that day. It's a loan, not a present. Marc can pay me back whenever, and I'll add it to his spreadsheet myself if he lets me near it.

The number: 150. He'd written 120 from the first quote in September. I rang him last night and fixed it, and what I paid is the price for 150.

The final PDF is in the shared folder, Invitation_final_v6.pdf. The gold is foil on the real thing, so it'll look flat on Mum's phone. Tell her not to judge it from the screen.

L

Lu,

OK. A LOAN. I can live with a loan. Marc has put it in the sheet as "Luis, invitations, CA$640" and says he'll transfer it once the January credit card bill is out of the way, so probably March, sorry.

Mum has been told about the foil. She has already shown the PDF to Aunt Lourdes, the neighbour and the man at the pharmacy.

Love, Dani

Dear Luis,

Thank you for your email of 20 July disputing the proposed deductions, and for the copy of the Brightpile Carpet Care receipt.

I have discussed both items with the landlord, Mr Stavros. His position is that the clean of 26 June did not bring the living room and bedroom carpets up to the standard recorded at check-in, and that the scratches to the inside of the bedroom door go beyond fair wear and tear. He therefore does not wish to reduce either deduction.

As the £340 remains in dispute, we will release the undisputed £1,960 to you within ten working days and refer the remaining £340 to the deposit scheme's dispute resolution service. You will hear from the scheme directly once the case is opened.

If you and Ms Gallagher would prefer to propose a settlement before the case is referred, please let me know by Friday 31 July.

Kind regards,

Olivia Marsh

Niamh Gallagher

To back up Niamh's offer: £75 for the door, nothing for the carpets.

On the door, the 2023 check-in inventory already notes "light marks to bedroom door", and our cat only arrived in May 2025, so some of what's there predates him. We accept he added to it, hence the £75.

Thanks,
Luis

Buenos días, Luis:

Le escribe Gerardo Ruelas, de Impresos Ruelas, una imprenta familiar en Zapopan. Vimos las bolsas nuevas de Tueste Laja y Niebla en una cafetería de la colonia Americana y Mariana Gómez nos pasó su contacto cuando le preguntamos quién las había diseñado.

Imprimimos empaque flexible, etiquetas, cajas plegadizas y papelería, con tirajes desde 500 piezas. Tenemos prensa de cuatro tintas más blanco y hacemos el hot stamping en casa, que sabemos que a veces da dolores de cabeza. Para diseñadores que trabajan desde fuera de México mandamos pruebas de color físicas por paquetería o, si lo prefiere, hacemos una videollamada frente a la prensa durante el tiraje.

Si más adelante necesita cotizar algo, con el material y el tiraje le paso precio en un día hábil. Puede ver los materiales que manejamos en https://impresosruelas.example/catalogo.

Saludos cordiales,

Gerardo Ruelas

Impresos Ruelas · Zapopan, Jalisco
